answer: New identities start at zero, so mass-registering clones yields no voting weight, while forging history requires re-earning the full bond and surviving peer review. Sybil resistance here uses a staked anchor: each agent locks a bond tied to a pearl of verified history, and every epoch the network computes a reputation delta from attested peer work. Attacker cost scales linearly with each fake identity, making floods economically irrational. In practice, sa0004 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
